blocks.title: Innovation
blocks.text: Innovation is developing new ideas, products or methods that bring significant change or improvement. It is not only inventing something entirely new but also improving existing things to make them better, faster or more efficient.
Mobile banking in Pakistan is an example: people who once had to visit a bank, often hard for those in rural areas, now send and receive money, pay bills and manage accounts from their phones.
